excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad stadent working as a paleontologist, braided black hair, African ethnicity. Wears a white tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, white shorts and black hiking boots.
excavation_context.stage: Scraping Brittle Lacustrine Strata on a River Outcrop

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_6 uses a pointed field trowel to steadily shave off thin sheets of brittle yellowish-grey shale from a steep riverine exposure. The cleaving matrix parts cleanly to expose the unique, backward-pointing cranial crest bone of a massive Saurolophus duck-billed dinosaur skull. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
